design_identity_policy: Allied display names and visual directions follow the latest design proposal; stable IDs, recipes, classifications, statistics and implemented gameplay remain unchanged. Basic families retain their existing runtime names and appearances.
production_note: All 92 allied A/B scripts have one completed Eleven v4 recording and are integrated for random selection playback. Actual allied cost is 3,212 credits. The remaining 61 enemy scripts, all music and all generated sound effects remain unproduced. Original character-count planning fields do not represent a new quote or current account balance.
golem_casting_note: The historical Ancient Monster candidate could not be revalidated in the current catalogue. Allied Golem now uses verified male Declan Sage for a slow deep stone guardian; historical enemy casting remains unchanged.
